031package dev.visdb.seesaw.decorators;
032
033import java.awt.Component;
034
035import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
036
037import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.Utils;
038import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
039
040/**
041 * The state of a component, focused/dirty/modified.
042 * Used to create a proper decoration
043 */
044// TODO: may want to treat as bit field for: error/focus/warning/dirty
045public enum ComponentState {
046  /** not focused, no error, not modified */
047  CLEAN,
048  /** focus gained, no error, not modified */
049  FOCUSED_CLEAN,
050  /** modified without focus */
051  MODIFIED,
052  /** modified with focus */
053  FOCUSED_MODIFIED,
054  /** error with/without focus */
055  ERROR,
056  /** error with/without focus */
057  FOCUSED_ERROR;
058
059  /**
060   * focused?
061   * @return
062   */
063  public boolean isFocused() {
064    return this == FOCUSED_CLEAN || this == FOCUSED_MODIFIED || this == FOCUSED_ERROR;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * modified?
069   * @return
070   */
071  public boolean isModified() {
072    return this == MODIFIED || this == FOCUSED_MODIFIED;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * focused?
077   * @return
078   */
079  public boolean isError() {
080    return this == ERROR || this == FOCUSED_ERROR;
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Determine the state of the component about focus/clean/dirty/error.
085   * @param comp
086   * @param valid
087   * @return the component state
088   */
089  public static ComponentState getComponentState(SsComponent comp,
090                                                 SsComponent.ValidationResult valid) {
091    ComponentState borderState;
092    if (valid.all())
093      borderState = comp.isDirty() ? MODIFIED : CLEAN;
094    else
095      borderState = ERROR;
096    Component f = Utils.getKFM().getFocusOwner();
097    if (f != null && SwingUtilities.isDescendingFrom(f, (Component) comp))
098      borderState = switch (borderState) {
099        case CLEAN -> FOCUSED_CLEAN;
100        case MODIFIED -> FOCUSED_MODIFIED;
101        case ERROR -> FOCUSED_ERROR;
102        default -> throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected value: " + (borderState));
103      };
104    return borderState;
105  }
106}
